title: Planning Commission And National Development Council History
definition: The Planning Commission (established in March 1950 via a Cabinet Resolution) and the National Development Council (established in August 1952) formed the bedrock of India's centralized economic planning era, which was eventually replaced by NITI Aayog in January 2015.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper 3 (Indian Economy and issues relating to planning, mobilization of resources) and Prelims (constitutional vs. extra-constitutional bodies, evolution of federal governance, developmental history).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Planning Commission And National Development Council History.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Indian Economy
